# Web reference images

Generate the requested web design references with an available image tool. Verify
its actual parameters; do not invent image output or prescribe another provider
when the required capability is unavailable. Prompt-only returns prompts without
an image call; this root never implements product code.

Allocate images from the selected scope and count. A requested hero is one hero;
named sections remain individually readable when section images were requested.
Respect a requested full-page composition rather than overriding it with a default
section pack. Keep one palette, type scale, component family and image treatment
across the set. Vary section rhythm according to content, not a fixed quota.

Inspect generated images for readable content, hierarchy, supplied factual text,
spacing, CTA priority and extractable detail. Refine only a missing requested outcome
within the budget. A fresh detail view can clarify an unreadable area when authorized;
do not crop or regenerate an immutable supplied parity target.

Present the actual images as the primary deliverable, identifying any unresolved
legibility or factual-text error. A concise chat report accompanies them; it does
not substitute prose for requested images.
